Principle12 : Marriage and My House Life
(How I met my husband)
My husband and I dated for five years before we got married.
Our wedding was beautiful all of my friends came and sang a song.
I will always remember that day with happiness.
Our personalities, hobbies and tastes are similar.
After we got married we enjoyed spending time and doing things together.
(My children)
I have two daughters and their personalities are very different.
The oldest daughter has an introspective personality and is very shy.
The youngest daughter is the opposite, she is very outgoing and likes all kinds of sports.
Even though they are very different they play well together.
(My family life)
I think our family is very happy.
We all take responsibility for our role in the family.
We always help each other. Every year once or twice we travel together.
My husband works very hard to provide for us.
My children study hard and I always take care of them.
I study everyday to prepare for my future.
